headline: Weathered Expanse Surges as Shelf Battle Holds Hot
war_summary: Overnight the centre of action has shifted to Weathered Expanse, which posts ten base changes in two hours and thirty-nine on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, latest minutes before three o'clock, standing four Warden to five Colonial amid day losses above thirteen thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden. Stlican Shelf remains busy with five changes in two hours and thirty-four on the day about Vulpine Watch, the Pale House, Thornhold and the Old Mourn, latest at the filing hour, holding six Warden, two Colonial and one destroyed. Fisherman's Row cools to two changes in two hours and thirty-nine on the day about Eidolo and Black Well, latest near two o'clock, now listed nine Colonial to none. Farranac Coast adds two changes in two hours about the Bone Haft, latest near two o'clock. Mooring County, Linn Mercy, Stonecradle and Godcrofts record no change in two hours, last turning between half-past eight and half-past midnight, while Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line show heavy casualties without a fresh flip.
